name: app/bar-chart
title: BarChart
summary: A bar chart rendered on the server as plain HTML: columns over time or labelled rows, the exact figures in a real table under "Show the figures", following the theme through tokens.

props.name: caption
props.description: One sentence: what is counted, over what range.

props.name: data
props.type: { label: string; value: number | null; long?: string }[]
props.description: The points; `long` is the table's label. A `null` value is withheld or unknown (for example a count suppressed for k-anonymity): it is never drawn or totalled as 0.

props.name: layout
props.description: Columns along the bottom, or one labelled bar per row.

props.name: missingLabel
props.description: What a null value reads as, in the figures table, the rows layout and a column's title, e.g. "Fewer than 5".

behaviour: The bars are aria-hidden; the figures table (with a total) is the accessible version.
No data, or every value 0 with none null: "Nothing to chart in this range."

A null value draws no bar. In columns it leaves a small muted baseline tick (`fill-muted-foreground`) on a column marked `data-missing`, whose title reads "<label>: <missingLabel>"; in rows the bar is empty and the value is the missingLabel in muted text.
The figures table shows the missingLabel (muted) for a null; the total sums the known values and reads "At least <n>" when any value is null (values are non-negative counts).
Every value null: "No figure in this range can be shown: <missingLabel, lower-cased> for every point."

Axis labels (columns) are thinned so they never crowd: always the first and the last, never one crowding the last; at most 6 from sm up, and below sm only the first, the middle (with at least 5 points) and the last.
Bar sizes are SVG geometry (a <rect>'s height or width in a 0–100 viewBox), never inline styles: a CSP needs no style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'.

suppressed.description: A k-anonymity-suppressed day: drawn as no bar, never as 0, and the total is a lower bound.

long.description: Twelve points: six axis labels from sm up, three on a phone.

aria: Bars aria-hidden; the table has a caption.

theming.brandOverlay: Bars are `--primary`, so they wear the brand mineral; the layout is identical.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Scales from 320px to 1920px without distorting text; the plot is 12rem tall, 14rem from sm.
Axis labels: at most 6 from sm up; first, middle and last below sm.
contract:
contract
  slot is "bar-chart"
  summary "Show the figures" min_height 44
  when default shows h3 "Sign-ups"
  when empty shows p "Nothing to chart in this range."
  when rows shows th "Admin"
  when suppressed shows td "At least 11"
  when suppressed-all shows p "No figure in this range can be shown: fewer than 5 for every point."
end

checks.say: Bars are hidden from screen readers.
Every value is in the table, with a total.
On a phone, twelve points show three axis labels.
From sm up, twelve points show six axis labels.
The first label is always shown.
The middle label is shown on a phone.
The last label is always shown.
No value is null by default, so no column is marked missing.
A null value is marked missing, and its title reads the missingLabel.
A null value draws a muted baseline tick, not a bar.
Only the known values draw bars.
The figures table shows the missingLabel, muted, for a null.
With a null, the total is a lower bound of the known values.
In rows, a null draws no bar.
In rows, a null's value is the missingLabel in muted text.
Every value null: the chart says no figure can be shown.
checks.text: No figure in this range can be shown: fewer than 5 for every point.

checks.say: Every value null: no bars are drawn.
